topics.title: Strange Boardwalk Musician and Oprah
topics.summary: Gary describes a woman playing the Casio with her tongue, two children, and past appearances on ABC news. The conversation shifts to concerns about ratings versus genuine interest in this individual’s story, followed by a discussion of Oprah's repeated broadcast of the segment featuring individuals who have had unusual experiences or disabilities.

topics.title: Radio Show Drug Concerns and Celebrity Commentary
topics.summary: A chaotic radio show features Stevie Wonder attempting to play an organ with his tongue, callers discussing Playboy magazine subscriptions, a convicted felon debating drug policy, and celebrity commentary from Arsenio Hall and Kirk Cameron. The discussion centers on the war on drugs, Hollywood's approach to addiction, and individual responsibility regarding substance use.

topics.title: Police Drug Testing Controversy
topics.summary: Following concerns about officer conduct, the New York City Police Department implemented a random drug testing program for all officers. The union voiced opposition citing broader anxieties regarding ‘the war on drugs,’ questioning whether such measures would deter misconduct or create new problems.

topics.title: Johnny’s Late-Night Urgency
topics.summary: During a late-night talk show segment, Howard recounts an awkward encounter with Johnny Carson after he experienced a sudden urge to urinate in a urinal. He describes the scene where Carson was standing nearby while others attempted to approach him and expresses embarrassment about his own reaction, including rushing into the bathroom himself.

topics.title: Wealthy Man's Isolation and Business Troubles
topics.summary: A wealthy man lives in a lavish house with a tennis court but is isolated from his family, leading to strained relationships. His business dealings involve questionable connections—a mob-linked bank loan and a dispute over the Aladdin Hotel with Wayne Newton—resulting in legal battles and NBC investigations.

topics.title: Stern Rants on Dice Clay and MTV Mishaps
topics.summary: Howard Stern dissects Andrew Dice Clay’s controversial performance at the MTV Awards following backstage antics with Steve Leeds and concerns about Arsenio Hall's hosting style. The segment includes colorful language, personal anecdotes, and a discussion of audience reactions to the situation.”} ”>
